messages.subject: Concordancing with Libreoffice and .csv files
parts:
Hello all.

So I'm doing some concordancing, mostly straight out of the book. If I'm writing the data with:
cat(file=file.name,'LEFT\tNODE\tRIGHT',hits,sep='\n')
is there some way I can get the LEFT column to be left-justified, the NODE to be centered, etc? Of course I can do it manually, but it's a bit annoying when dealing with a lot of concordance files.

I know that .csv files have no formatting at all, so perhaps it's possible to have a second script load the files and rewrite them in a format that allows formatting code?


--
Kevin Parent, Ph.D
Korea Maritime University
Chair, Korea Toastmasters Territorial Council
